tools.name: find_tokens
tools.title: Find tokens
tools.description: List BaseStonk launches: what is trending (the default), the newest (sort "age"), the largest, the most traded or the most held - optionally narrowed by a name, ticker or address fragment. Each row has price, fully-diluted market cap, 24h change, volume, holders, pair, age and a link. To look at ONE token in detail use get_token.

tools.name: get_platform
tools.title: Platform
tools.description: BaseStonk as a whole. "stats": tokens launched, trades, volume, holders, revenue to creators and the platform, dividends paid through baskets (the default). "burn": how much $BSTONK has been burnt, in-pool and by buyback - the flywheel number. "basket": what the $BSTONK dividend basket has paid holders, IN KIND as wrapped stocks, majors and memes, round by round. "comps": BaseStonk against other launchpads on fees and volume per dollar of market cap. burn and basket are about $BSTONK, which lives on Base.

include.description: Which parts to return. Default: stats.

chain.description: For stats: base (default), robinhood or arc. burn, basket and comps are not per chain.

basketRounds.description: For basket: how many recent payout rounds to list.

tools.name: check_pair
tools.title: Check a launch pair
tools.description: Can a token be launched paired against this asset? Checks whether the pair is admitted and deep enough on that chain. Pass a ticker (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, AAPLc, SPY…) or an address.

status.description: "step" means launchable after the action in `sentence`; it is not a refusal.

priceUsd.description: US dollars. null means not known - never read it as zero.

tools.name: launch_link
tools.title: Link to launch on basestonk.io
tools.description: Build a basestonk.io/create link with the launch form pre-filled, plus a handle for get_intent. Checks the pair first and refuses one the chain would refuse. This tool only returns a URL: nothing is deployed, signed or sent here. The user opens the link in their browser and decides there, in their own wallet. Afterwards, get_intent with the handle reports whether a token went live at that address.

pair.description: Pair ticker or address (default $BSTONK on Base). A pair is permanent - confirm it with the user.

marketCapUsd.description: Opening fully-diluted market cap in USD (default 3000).

template.description: A partner preset id. Its chain, pair, taxes and payee split come from the preset, which this tool reads and states in its answer; do not pass pair with it.

id.description: The handle. Pass it back to get_intent unchanged to learn whether the user completed it on the site.

url.description: Where the user reviews and signs, in their own wallet.

marketCapUsd.description: US dollars. null means not known - never read it as zero.

preset.description: The partner preset as the API serves it, read at call time - its pair, taxes and payee split are the preset's, never a copy carried here.

tools.name: trade_link
tools.title: Link to a token page on basestonk.io
tools.description: Build a link to a token's basestonk.io page with the amount box pre-filled, plus a handle for get_intent. Resolves the token without guessing between tokens that share a ticker. This tool only returns a URL: nothing is executed, signed or sent here. The user opens the link in their browser and decides there, in their own wallet. Afterwards, get_intent with the handle and a wallet reports whether that wallet completed it on the site.

token.description: Token address (0x…) or ticker symbol, e.g. "BSTONK" or "$GROK". An address is exact; a ticker several launches share is answered with the candidates to choose from.

amount.description: Amount to pre-fill in the buy box, in units of the PAIR token this launch trades against (dollars only when the pair is a stablecoin). Ask the user which if unsure.

annotations.title: Link to a token page on basestonk.io

id.description: The handle. Pass it back to get_intent unchanged to learn whether the user completed it on the site.

resolvedBy.description: How the reference given to the tool was matched to this token.

note.description: Set when the match needs saying - other tokens share the ticker, or it was not an exact match.

amount.description: Pre-filled buy size. `unit` is the PAIR token symbol, which is dollars only when the pair is a stablecoin.

marketCapUsd.description: US dollars. null means not known - never read it as zero.

tools.name: get_intent
tools.title: Check a link
tools.description: Did the user complete what a launch_link or trade_link pointed at, on the site? Read from the public chain index; this tool cannot see or affect the user's wallet. Pass the handle back unchanged. A launch answers with the new token address once it is on chain. A buy needs the buyer wallet, because a buy on a public pool cannot be attributed to a draft any other way.

intent.description: The intent.id a draft returned, unchanged.

wallet.description: For a buy: the wallet that bought.

id.description: The handle. Pass it back to get_intent unchanged to learn whether the user completed it on the site.

status.description: done: found on chain. not_seen: nothing matching yet. ambiguous: more than one match. needs_wallet: a buy can only be found with the buyer wallet. expired: drafted over seven days ago and never seen.

token.description: For a launch: the token it created.

candidates.description: Set when several launches match the draft.
